name: Cu Lao Cham Reserve
nameVi: Khu bảo tồn thiên nhiên Cù Lao Chàm
kicker: Zoned water around the islands off Hoi An
summary: Cross for water that is zoned, not for an open beach. The visit fee is 70,000 VND a person from 10 June 2026, and the boat is extra. The 2020 reserve names seven islands. The 2026 city page says eight. Skip a swim in the strict zone.
getThere: Boat from the Cửa Đại pier. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Clear water against the forested shore of the reserve

notice.title: The visit fee is not the boat
notice.body: 70,000 VND per person per visit, from 10 June 2026, is the reserve charge. No boat fare was printed on the fee pages. Check the fare on arrival.

body: The water you cross is a reserve, not a beach with one ticket. The 17 July 2020 decision names seven islands: Hòn Lao, Hòn Cụ, Hòn Khô, Hòn Lá, Hòn Dài, Hòn Mồ, and Hòn Tai, and 23,500 hectares. The environment ministry’s 25 February 2025 notice repeats those seven names and gives the newer nature reserve 23,530 hectares. The city portal on 30 June 2026 says the cluster is eight islands and about 15 km² of land. Keep both island counts. Do not average the hectare figures.

Hòn Lao is the largest island and the only one with residents. The biodiversity agency also says eight islands, about 15 km², 18 km from Hoi An, and 947 aquatic species, and it dates the UNESCO designation to 29 May 2009. The visit-fee resolution uses 26 May as the UNESCO anniversary and does not narrate the session. The UNESCO page itself did not load, so it is not the source for the species count or the day.

Tourism is not listed in the strict zone. Ecotourism in the restoration zone is allowed only when it does not harm the fishery or the marine ecosystem, and tourism boats may not anchor on coral or seagrass. Restoration water named in 2020 includes Rạn Mành, part of Hòn Tai, Bãi Nần, Rạn Mè – Bãi Ông, and Hòn Dài. Strict water includes Hòn Tai, Bãi Tra, the north of Hòn Lao, Hòn Mồ, Hòn Lá, and Hòn Cụ with Hòn Khô. A snorkel price was not printed.

figures.caption: The long forested island and smaller islets, from the water
figures.alt: A forested island shore and smaller green islets across the water at Cu Lao Cham

gettingThere: The boat pier named on 30 August 2023 is bến thủy nội địa Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm, with the Cửa Đại border checkpoint. Passengers were described from 08:00, crowded from 08:00 to 10:00, heaviest in summer, holidays, and Tết. Life jackets are checked before a boat is cleared. That page does not print a fare, a return clock, or a minute count.

The city temple page says Hải Tạng is about 20 km from the Hoi An shore. The biodiversity agency says the commune is 18 km from Hoi An. Use both. The desk that collects the 70,000 VND was not given an address. Where you pay is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoi An
legs.body: Boat from bến thủy nội địa Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm. The city page says about 20 km from the Hoi An shore to Hải Tạng. The biodiversity agency says 18 km from Hoi An. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: Da Nang International is VVDN on the civil-aviation AIP, southwest of the city and 3.2 km from the city centre. The road from the airport to the Cửa Đại pier was not given a minute count. Check it on arrival, then take the boat.

hours: Check on arrival. The 2023 pier report describes passengers from 08:00. It is not a gate hour for the reserve.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed. A month when the pier stops was not on the 2023 report. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: 70,000 VND per person per visit, Resolution 16/2026/NQ-HĐND, signed 29 May 2026, in force 10 June 2026. The collector is Ban quản lý Khu bảo tồn Thiên nhiên Cù Lao Chàm. The same text is on the city Fatherland Front site and the Hương Trà ward site. Free of that fee: Vietnamese citizens with a disability certificate under Decree 28/2012/NĐ-CP; Vietnamese citizens under the cultural-access policy in Article 2 of Decision 170/2003/QĐ-TTg; children under 16 and pupils under the Education Law; Vietnamese citizens 60 and over; poor and near-poor households under the government poverty line; diplomatic guests on a central or Da Nang program; citizens of xã Tân Hiệp. Free days for everyone: four Tết days, from 29 or 30 tháng Chạp through the end of mùng 3 tháng Giêng; 29 March; 26 May; 2 September. The boat is not inside the 70,000 VND. The boat fare is check on arrival.
